item.description:
What's new in 0.1.50

  • Full app localization: every screen now speaks all 10 languages - the Status home, Apps & Tools, Battery, Notifications, Notch, Screensaver, Shortcuts, Stats and About, plus the menu-bar dropdown, the notch widget, the screensaver overlay, notifications and system menus. The bits that stayed English before (mode chips, tool subtitles, Working/Idle, stats and update labels, shortcut names) are all translated now.
  • New: choose your language on the first onboarding screen, not just in Settings.
  • Switching language now relaunches instantly - no extra confirmation dialog.
  • Fixed: the final onboarding screen no longer pushed the "Open AwakeMate" button out of view in longer languages.
  • The weekly stats chart now shows weekday names in your language.
